assets.title: Crusher transfer chute
assets.description: Conveyor-to-conveyor transfer chute at about real size: upper 1200 mm troughed conveyor with head pulley, gearbox and motor discharging into a curved head hood; tapering lofted chute body with flanged joints and bolted wear liner panels; spoon and skirt boards onto a loaded receiving conveyor below; two hinged inspection doors; dust extraction duct; four-column head tower with bracing; grated access platform with handrails and ladder. Layout choice (rightAngle, inline) turns the receiving belt; door choice (closed, open). Material controls: chute paint, frame steel, belt rubber and wear liner. weathered, plantGreen and highVisibility presets.

assets.title: Double-deck vibrating screen
assets.description: Inclined double-deck vibrating screen at about real size: 6 m by 2.4 m body of stiffened side plates and tubular cross-members, modular top-deck panels carrying ore and a lower deck, exciter beam with unbalance housings driven by a cardan shaft from a stand-mounted motor, four corner coil springs on a steel stand, feed box at the high end, oversize and mid-size discharge lips at the low end, undersize hopper. Material controls: screen body coating, stand steel, screen panel polyurethane, springs and exciter steel, plus an incline choice (15, 20, 25 degrees). weathered, highVisibility and greyPlant presets.

assets.title: Flotation cell bank
assets.description: Bank of round forced-air flotation tank cells at about real size: 4.4 m tanks stepping down from feed to tail on concrete plinths, mineral froth surfaces spilling into external ring launders, drive bridges with mechanism motor, belt guard and rotor shaft, junction boxes with dart-valve actuators between cells, feed box, tailings box, air header with a drop and butterfly valve to each cell, concentrate launders falling to a collection pipe, walkway with handrails and stair. Material controls: tank coating, walkway and drive steel, rubber-lined launders and hoses, froth colour, plus a cell-count choice (3, 4, 5). weathered, highVisibility and copperFroth presets.

assets.title: Flotation conditioning tank
assets.description: Agitated flotation conditioning tank at about real size: 3.5 m open-topped steel tank with stiffener rings, slurry surface and four wall baffles, bridge beams with grated walkway and handrails, vertical agitator motor with fan cowl on a gearbox, agitator shaft, feed pipe over the rim, yellow reagent dosing lines, overflow box with discharge pipe, and a caged access ladder. Support choice: flat bottom on a concrete ring plinth, or cone bottom with drain valve on four braced legs. Material controls: tank paint, walkway steel, drive paint and slurry. weathered, processBlue and highVisibility presets.

assets.title: Grizzly scalping deck
assets.description: Vibrating grizzly feeder at about real size: sloping tray with shaped side plates, stiffeners and top flanges, a manganese liner pan under the feed end, two stepped decks of heavy grizzly bars on cross beams, twin unbalanced vibrator motors on the side plates, four coil-spring sets on spring brackets and steel pedestals, a fines chute under the bars, ore on the feed pan and oversize boulders on the bars. Material controls: tray coating, support steel, manganese bars and liners, and ore, plus a bar gap choice (75, 100 or 150 mm) that sets the number of grizzly bars. weathered, highVisibility and orangePlant presets.

assets.title: Gyratory crusher station
assets.description: Primary gyratory crusher station at about real size: bottom shell with countershaft arm, middle shell and flaring top shell whose throat shows the manganese mantle head in a bowl of rock, spider beam and cap, horizontal countershaft with coupling and motor, discharge chute into the pit below, concrete pit walls forming the truck dump pocket, dump deck with wheel stop, operator deck with handrails and a pedestal rock breaker for oversize. Material controls: crusher shell coating, deck and drive steel, manganese wear steel, pit concrete, plus a rock-breaker choice (fitted, none). weathered, highVisibility and yellowPlant presets.

assets.title: High-pressure grinding rolls
assets.description: HPGR roller press at about real size: two studded rolls with cheek plates in a heavy rectangular machine frame on concrete plinths, fixed and floating bearing blocks, horizontal hydraulic pressing cylinders with nitrogen accumulators and a hydraulic power unit, choke feed chute and bin loaded with ore over the nip, twin drive trains of cardan shafts, planetary gearboxes and motors on a drive plinth, and a product belt under the rolls carrying pressed cake. Material controls: frame coating, drive and bin steel, studded roll tyres, belts and rubber, plus a roll size choice (1.7, 2.0 or 2.4 m diameter) that resizes the whole machine. weathered, highVisibility and bluePlant presets.

assets.title: Hydrocyclone cluster
assets.description: Radial hydrocyclone cluster at about real size: ring of rubber-lined cyclones with cylindrical heads, tangential feed inlets with knife-gate valves and long cones to the apex, round a central feed distributor with pressure gauge; overflow pipes turning into a ring overflow launder, apex sprays into an underflow launder, column-supported ring platform with handrail and ladder, main feed pipe from the pump. Material controls: cyclone body coating, platform and launder steel, rubber lining and hoses, valve steel, plus a cyclone count choice (6, 8, 10). weathered, highVisibility and greyPlant presets.

assets.title: Impact crusher module
assets.description: Horizontal-shaft impact crusher at about real size on a raised steel module: square lower housing with an inspection door, rounded impact hood hinged at the back with hydraulic opening cylinders, liner bolt rows and stiffening ribs, apron adjustment spindles, heavy rotor with four manganese blow bars, grooved flywheel sheave on V-belts from a drive motor on its own deck, inclined feed chute carrying run-of-mine rock, discharge chute and inclined product conveyor, service deck with handrail and ladder. Material controls: crusher coating, module and drive steel, manganese wear parts, belts and rubber, plus a hood choice (closed for running, open for a blow-bar change showing the rotor). weathered, highVisibility and greenPlant presets.

assets.title: Jaw crusher module
assets.description: Primary jaw crusher at about real size on a raised steel stand: thick profiled side plates and front wall, fixed and swing jaws with ridged manganese liners forming a V chamber full of rock, eccentric shaft in pillow blocks, a spoked flywheel and a grooved drive sheave, V-belt drive from a motor on a pivoting base, rear toggle adjustment cylinders and tension rod with spring, and an inclined discharge conveyor under the crusher carrying crushed ore. Material controls: crusher body coating, stand and drive steel, belts and rubber, manganese liners; weathered, highVisibility and yellowPlant presets.

assets.title: Longwall shearer
assets.description: Double-ended ranging-drum longwall shearer at about real size on a section of armoured face conveyor: long body with haulage units, control box and lights on an underframe that rides the conveyor, two ranging arms with lift cylinders and spiral-vaned cutter drums carrying picks, leading drum on the roof and trailing drum on the floor, coal face showing the uncut web ahead and the lower bench between the drums, conveyor pans with flight bars, toe ramp, spill plate, rack bar and cable trough, cut coal on the conveyor, and two two-leg hydraulic roof shields ahead of the leading drum. Material controls: shearer paint, conveyor and shield steel, drum and pick steel, hoses and cable, plus a seam height choice (2.5, 3.2, 4.0 m) that sets the drum size, arm angles and shield height. weathered, eickhoffGreen and highVisibility presets.

assets.title: Wet magnetic separator
assets.description: Wet drum low-intensity magnetic separator at about real size: 1200 mm stainless drum on a through shaft in a U-shaped slurry tank, slurry level in the tank, end flanges, bearing pedestals on a legged steel frame, geared drive motor at one end, magnet-arc adjustment lever with quadrant at the other, feed box with feed pipe, wash-water spray pipe over the drum, concentrate launder with outlet pipe, tails spigots with pinch valves under the tank, and an access platform with handrail. Material controls: tank paint, drum stainless, frame steel and slurry, plus a stage choice (single drum or two drums in series). weathered, plantBlue and highVisibility presets.

assets.title: Conveyor metal detector arch
assets.description: Conveyor metal detector at about real size: rectangular search-coil frame with corner gussets and junction box standing around a 1200 mm troughed ore belt, fibreglass non-metallic zone (stringer bridge and three-roll fibreglass idlers) through the coil, steel conveyor beyond it with steel idlers, legs, return belt and return idlers, control enclosure on a post with display, keypad and beacon stack, conduit to the coil, and a paint-marker spray unit downstream. Material controls: detector paint, conveyor steel, belt rubber and fibreglass, plus an alarm choice (clear with a green beacon, tripped with a red beacon, steel in the coil and a paint mark on the ore). weathered, safetyYellow and highVisibility presets.

assets.title: Mill feed chute
assets.description: SAG mill feed chute at about real size: mill feed conveyor end with belt, ore load, troughed idlers, stringers and head pulley inside a head hood, sloped open trough with rubber wear liners and an ore stream, drop box with inspection doors and handles, feed spout on a wheeled trolley on rails entering the mill trunnion, process water pipe to the spout, support columns and an access platform with handrail. The mill feed end is shown for context: trunnion, bearing pedestal, feed-end cone and shell. Spout choice: in service (pushed into the trunnion) or retracted for relining. Material controls: chute paint, wear liner rubber, mill shell and ore. weathered, mineGreen and highVisibility presets.

assets.title: Mill relining machine
assets.description: Rail-mounted mill relining machine at about real size: wheeled carriage on two rails and sleepers, slewing ring and pedestal, 7 m box-section boom with a telescopic inner stage, two boom lift cylinders, rotating wrist and hydraulic grab holding a curved liner plate by its lifter bar, tail counterweight, hydraulic power unit with hoses run along the boom, operator cab with windows and beacon, and deck handrails. Reach choice (retracted, extended) slides the inner stage; load choice (liner, empty) fills the grab. Material controls: machine paint, frame steel, hydraulic hose and liner steel. weathered, safetyOrange and whiteFleet presets.

assets.title: Underground mine locomotive
assets.description: Narrow-gauge underground trolley locomotive at about real size: low outside plate frame with flanged wheels, axle boxes and sand boxes, sloped louvred motor hood, open operator compartment under a steel canopy with seat, controller, brake handwheel and windscreen, striped buffer beams with coupler pockets, link-and-pin couplers and headlights at both ends, trolley pole and shoe on the overhead wire with a gallows support, on 914 mm gauge rails, ties and ballast. Material controls: body coating, frame and rail steel, rubber, lamp glass; weathered, highVisibility and greenFleet presets.

assets.title: Mine refuge chamber
assets.description: Portable underground refuge chamber at about real size: chamfered steel shell with stiffener ribs on a sled skid with upturned runners and tow eyes, pressure door with porthole, locking wheel and hinges (closed or open showing the dark airlock), side portholes, reflective bands, green REFUGE sign, breathing-air cylinder rack, roof air conditioning and scrubber unit with fan, strobe beacon, aerial and lifting lugs, and a compressed-air and phone connection panel. Size choice: eight-person (4.2 m) or twenty-person (7.2 m). Material controls: shell paint, skid steel, air cylinder paint and window glass. weathered, mineGreen and highVisibility presets.

assets.title: Mine skip conveyance
assets.description: Bottom-dump shaft skip at about real size: 7 m open-topped vessel with stiffening bands and a floor sloping to a hinged front dump door with cam roller, manganese wear liners on the rim, bridle with side stiles, crosshead and transom, guide shoes and rollers on two steel shaft guides tied to buntons, cappel socket and head rope, landing keps on a concrete station floor. Material controls: skip body coating, bridle and guide steel, manganese wear liners, ore, plus a gate choice (loaded with the door shut, or dumping with the door open and ore pouring onto a pile). weathered, highVisibility and blueHoist presets.

assets.title: Mine sump pump
assets.description: Underground sump pump station at about real size: drive floor with a concrete-lined 2.4 m sump pit holding mine water, handrail with toe boards round the pit, starter panel on a stand with door, lamps and isolator, float switch, and a choice of pump. Vertical spindle pump: motor with fan cowl and terminal box on a motor stool, baseplate on two steel beams, column pipe to a pump bowl and strainer in the water, discharge leg with check valve, gate valve and handwheel, flanged riser with support post. Submersible pump: pump with motor cap and lifting handle hung on a chain from an A-frame, lay-flat discharge hose over the pit lip. Material controls: pump paint, pipe steel, concrete and mine water. weathered, mineGreen and highVisibility presets.

assets.title: Mine survey tripod
assets.description: Mine survey set-up at real size: surveying tripod with three splayed twin-bar legs, aluminium sliding extensions with clamp blocks and screws, steel shoes with spikes and kick spurs, triangular head plate and centring screw, tribrach with three levelling screws, and an instrument choice. Total station: base with circular level, two standards, telescope with objective and eyepiece on the trunnion axis, screen and keypad, side drive knobs and carry handle. Laser scanner: box body with screen, two uprights and a mirror drum. A prism pole with circular prism, red and white bands and a bipod, and a hard carry case with handle and latches stand beside it. Material controls: tripod legs, leg metal, instrument housing and instrument trim. weathered, timberTripod and highVisibility presets.

assets.title: Mine ventilation fan station
assets.description: Surface main ventilation fan station at about real size: 3 m axial fan casing with flanges and stiffening rings, square inlet box with isolation damper and actuator, inlet duct rising out of a concrete upcast shaft collar, evase diffuser bending into a vertical discharge stack with a flared mouth, in-line drive motor on a pedestal with coupling guard and shaft, cable tray to an electrical house with VSD, door and air-conditioner. Material controls: fan and duct coating, structural steel, shaft-collar concrete, E-house cladding, plus a fan arrangement choice (single, twin duty/standby). weathered, highVisibility and greyPlant presets.

assets.title: Ore-pass grizzly
assets.description: Underground ore-pass tipping point at about real size: 5.4 m concrete collar around a 3 m square pass opening, two cross bearers carrying seven rail-section grizzly bars at a 400 mm aperture, striped steel bump rail on the tipping side, pedestal rock breaker with slew ring, boom, stick and hydraulic hammer folded over the bars, guard posts with chain along both sides and an amber beacon post. Rock choice (oversize, clear) puts broken oversize on the bars. Material controls: collar concrete, grizzly steel, hazard paint and rock. weathered, freshShotcrete and darkOre presets.

assets.title: Ore sorting sensor arch
assets.description: Sensor-based ore sorter at about real size: vibrating feeder with feed hopper, unbalanced motors and spring mounts; 4.2 m flat 1200 mm belt in an enclosed side frame; sensor arch over the belt (X-ray source, detector line and shielding tunnel with lead curtains, or optical camera bar with LED light lines); air-jet ejector manifold with nozzle row; rocks on the belt and in flight, rejected rocks blown into the near chute; splitter plate; lofted product and waste chutes onto two cross belts; discharge housing; control cabinet with HMI and stack light. Sensor choice (xrt, optical) and housing choice (open, closed). Material controls: housing paint, frame steel, accent paint and ore. weathered, copperOre and darkPanel presets.

assets.title: Overland conveyor bridge
assets.description: Overland conveyor road crossing at about real size: 26 m box truss gallery with top and bottom chords, verticals, diagonals, floor beams and top lateral ties, carried 6 m above a haul road on two braced four-legged towers with concrete footings, a 1200 mm troughed belt on three-roll idler sets with return belt and arched belt hoods, a grated walkway along one side and a clearance sign over the road. Cover choice (hooded, open) and load choice (loaded, empty). Material controls: truss steel, belt hood sheeting, belt rubber and ore. weathered, coalHandling and desertRed presets.

assets.title: Radial stacker conveyor
assets.description: Pivoting radial stacker at about real size: 30 m trussed boom with chords, verticals and diagonals, troughed belt carrying a ridge of ore up to a head pulley under a discharge hood with drive gearbox and motor, side walkway with handrail, feed hopper and skirt board over the tail pulley on a pinned pivot base, wheeled undercarriage with A-frame legs, lift ram and tyres aligned to the swing arc, and a conical stockpile under the discharge. Material controls: boom coating, undercarriage and walkway steel, belt and tyre rubber, stockpile ore, plus a boom angle choice (10, 14, 18 degrees) that resizes the pile. weathered, highVisibility and ironOre presets.

assets.title: Pedestal rock breaker
assets.description: Pedestal rock-breaker system at about real size: concrete plinth with anchor-bolted base plate, tapered steel pedestal, slewing ring and turret with slew cylinders, tapered main boom and stick with boom, stick and tool cylinders, hydraulic hammer with chisel, hose bundle along the boom, hydraulic power unit with motor, oil cooler and tank, remote control station, and a grizzly of heavy steel bars over an ore pit between concrete walls carrying oversize boulders, one under the chisel. Two yellow warning posts stand on bolted base plates centered on the long pit wall. Material controls: boom paint, pedestal and grizzly steel, hammer steel and concrete, plus a pose choice (working with the chisel on a boulder, parked folded over the plinth). weathered, safetyYellow and highVisibility presets.

assets.title: Roof-bolting rig
assets.description: Twin-boom crawler roof bolter at about real size: crawler tracks with grouser shoes, low chassis with deck, two drill masts on swing booms with climbing drill heads, chucks, drill steels and centralisers, ATRS roof-support beam on twin lift cylinders, two operator platforms with lever banks under canopies on posts, bolt and resin magazines, dust collector box with vacuum hoses to the masts, hydraulic tank, electrical enclosure and cable reel with trailing cable. Material controls: machine paint, frame and track steel, drill steel and chrome, hoses and rubber, plus a mast choice (stowed for tramming, drilling with masts and ATRS raised to a 3.2 m roof). weathered, permissibleWhite and highVisibility presets.

assets.title: Rotary blasthole drill rig
assets.description: Rotary blasthole drill at about real size, drilling: 17 m lattice mast with crown sheaves, rotary head and drill pipe through a dust-collector skirt into the ground with a ring of cuttings at the collar, pipe carousel and raising cylinders; crawler tracks with sprockets, idlers and grousers, four levelling jacks, machinery house with louvres, radiator grille and exhaust stack, glazed cab, deck handrails and access ladder. Material controls: coated body steel, mast and frame steel, drill pipe steel, rubber and hoses; weathered, highVisibility and blueFleet presets.

assets.title: Run-of-mine hopper
assets.description: ROM dump hopper at about real size: inverted-pyramid steel bin with ribbed sloped walls, wear-plate rim and a square discharge throat with hydraulic flop gate, four braced columns with a ring beam, a static grizzly of heavy rails across the mouth holding oversize boulders, a concrete retaining wall and truck tipping deck with bump block, tipping traffic signal and dust-suppression spray bar. Material controls: hopper coating, columns and grizzly steel, retaining wall concrete and run-of-mine ore, plus a load choice (full with a heap and boulders, or empty showing the liners). weathered, highVisibility and blueBin presets.

assets.title: SAG grinding mill
assets.description: Semi-autogenous grinding mill at about real size: 8 m shell with bolted flanges and liner-bolt rows, conical feed and discharge heads on hollow trunnions in hooded bearings on concrete piers, guarded girth gear with pinion, gearbox and finned motor, stationary feed chute with square hopper, discharge trommel over a sump, lube unit and access walkway with handrails. Material controls: mill shell coating, structural steel, trunnion and trommel steel, concrete; weathered, highVisibility and greyPlant presets.

assets.title: Mine shaft headframe
assets.description: Steel mine shaft headframe at about real size: 24 m four-legged braced tower over a concrete shaft collar, two inclined back legs with struts, sheave deck with handrails and two 4.4 m spoked winding sheaves on bearing beams, hoist ropes down to a cage at the collar and a skip high in the tower and across to a gabled winder house, and a caged access ladder. Material controls: headframe steel, sheave and rope steel, cage and winder-house cladding, concrete; weathered, highVisibility and redOxide presets.

assets.title: Slurry pump skid
assets.description: Horizontal centrifugal slurry pump on a skid at about real size: split volute casing with a ring of clamp bolts and lifting lugs, end suction spool with rubber expansion joint and knife-gate valve, tangential discharge riser with pressure gauge and flanged elbow, pedestal bearing frame with shaft and adjustment bolts, gland-seal water line, drain trough, and a motor either on an overhead frame with V-belts in a guard or coupled in line behind the bearing frame. Material controls: pump casing coating, skid and frame steel, rubber hoses and joints, valve and shaft steel, plus a drive choice (overhead, inline). weathered, highVisibility and greyPlant presets.

assets.title: Spiral concentrator bank
assets.description: Bank of gravity spiral concentrators at about real size: helical fibreglass troughs winding four turns down round central columns, slurry spread across each trough with a dark heavy-mineral band on the inner edge, a feed box at the top of each spiral fed by hoses from a round feed distributor on the top beam, product splitter boxes at the foot with concentrate, middlings and tailings hoses into three launders, and a steel bay frame on a concrete plinth. Material controls: trough fibreglass, frame steel, slurry, heavy-mineral concentrate, plus a spiral count choice (2, 3, 4). weathered, highVisibility and ilmeniteSand presets.

assets.title: Stacker reclaimer boom
assets.description: Rail-mounted bucket-wheel stacker reclaimer at about real size: four rail bogies with sixteen wheels, portal, slewing ring and superstructure with machinery house; 28 m lattice boom with conveyor belt, ore load and walkway; bucket wheel with ten toothed buckets, spokes and drive on the boom tip; luffing cylinders, A-frame mast with stays to the boom and to a rear counterweight boom; operator cab on the boom; yard conveyor alongside the rails with a trailing tripper; and a stockpile with half-cone ends. Mode choice (reclaim, stack) luffs the boom; slew choice (onPile, parked). Material controls: machine paint, frame steel, belt rubber and stockpile. weathered, coalYard and bauxiteYard presets.

assets.title: Tailings filter press
assets.description: Sidebar plate-and-frame tailings filter press at about real size: pack of 2 m square polypropylene filter plates hung on twin side bars, fixed feed head with feed pipe and filtrate manifolds, moving head driven by a hydraulic closing cylinder in a rear cylinder head with power pack, plate-shifter carriage, drip-tray doors, raised on a steel structure with walkways and handrails over a concrete cake bay holding a pile of discharged cake. Material controls: press frame coating, structure and walkway steel, filter plate polypropylene, cake bay concrete, plus a cycle choice (filtering, discharging). weathered, highVisibility and whitePlates presets.

assets.title: Tailings stack conveyor
assets.description: Crawler-mounted dry-stack tailings stacker at about real size: 22 m tubular lattice boom with chords, verticals and diagonals rising at 16 degrees from a pinned tail skid, troughed belt carrying filter cake on three-roll idlers, square feed hopper over the tail pulley, head pulley under a discharge hood with gearbox and motor, side walkway with handrails, A-frame struts and a luffing ram down to a crawler carrier with two tracked undercarriages, grousers, sprockets and a diesel power pack with exhaust, and a terraced dry stack of tailings benched in lifts under the head. Stack choice (terraced, none) and load choice (loaded, empty). Material controls: boom paint, crawler steel, belt rubber and tailings. weathered, ironTailings and coalReject presets.

assets.title: Tailings thickener bridge
assets.description: Bridge-type tailings thickener at about real size: 22 m elevated steel tank on a ring of columns with a conical floor and underflow cone, settled water surface with a notched overflow weir and external launder discharging to an overflow box, centre feedwell fed by a pipe carried along a trussed walkway bridge with handrails, central drive head with gearbox, twin motors and rake-lift cylinder, rake-arm crossbar showing at the surface, underflow pump and pipe under the centre. Material controls: tank coating, bridge and column steel, drive coating, process water colour, plus a bridge choice (half, full). weathered, highVisibility and clearWater presets.

assets.title: Rotary trommel screen
assets.description: Rotary trommel screen at about real size: 7 m inclined drum with perforated screen panels in a cage of stiffening rings and longitudinal strakes, blank feed section and feed chute from a hopper of ore, two riding tyres on trunnion rollers with a geared motor driving one roller, spray-water bar with drop nozzles, undersize hopper over a cross conveyor building a fines pile, and an oversize chute dropping rock onto a pile, standing on a steel frame or on a tandem-axle trailer chassis. Material controls: drum and hopper coating, frame steel, screen panels, ore, plus a mounting choice (fixed, mobile). weathered, highVisibility and gravelWash presets.

assets.title: Underground shuttle car
assets.description: Electric underground shuttle car at about real size: low wide tub with side boards cut out over four rubber tyres, chain conveyor bed with flight bars running from the low loading end up the raised discharge boom, head shaft and discharge lip, side-sitting operator pocket with seat, steering wheel and canopy on posts, cable reel with spooling guide and trailing cable, traction motor housings, hydraulic tank, bumpers and headlights at both ends. Material controls: body paint, chassis steel, conveyor wear steel and tyre rubber, plus a load choice (loaded with a coal heap, empty). weathered, joyWhite and highVisibility presets.

assets.title: Vacuum disc filter
assets.description: Vacuum disc filter for concentrate dewatering at about real size: 2.7 m cloth-covered discs built from sectors on one horizontal hollow shaft, dipping into a U-shaped slurry trough with a compartment per disc, filter cake on the rising side, cake discharge chutes between the discs and a cake belt conveyor along the front, filter valve with vacuum lines to a vertical vacuum receiver and filtrate pump, shaft-mounted gearbox and motor, bearing pedestals, trough support frame and a rear service platform with handrails. Disc choice (6, 8) and cake choice (loaded, clean). Material controls: tank steel, filter cloth, filter cake and drive paint. weathered, copperConcentrate and ironOre presets.

assets.title: Accordion
assets.description: Piano accordion at real size: zig-zag pleated bellows with nickel corner guards between two lacquered cases, a fretted treble grille, a full ivory and ebony piano keyboard, register switches, a staggered grid of bass buttons and leather hand and shoulder straps. Material controls: case lacquer, bellows fabric, ivory and ebony keys, nickel hardware, leather straps. Concert, vintage and pearl presets.

assets.title: Acoustic guitar
assets.description: Low-poly acoustic guitar with a waisted body, sound hole, long neck and tuning head.

assets.title: Alto saxophone
assets.description: Saxophone with bent neck, broad bell and raised pearl-like key buttons.

assets.title: Banjo
assets.description: Banjo with a circular resonator, narrow neck, bridge and tuning head.

assets.description: Large concert bass drum on a floor cradle with a broad circular drumhead.

assets.description: Electric bass guitar prop with an elongated body, long fretted neck and four strings.

assets.title: Bassoon
assets.description: Bassoon prop with paired long bores, curved bocal and grouped keywork.

assets.title: Bongos
assets.description: Small paired bongo drums joined by a center bridge and supported on a low base.

assets.title: Cajon
assets.description: Peruvian box drum with a broad front striking panel, low-profile feet and top seat edge.

assets.title: Cello
assets.description: Seated cello with a broad resonant body, long neck, bridge and extended endpin.

assets.title: Clarinet
assets.description: Straight clarinet with a flared bell, mouthpiece and regularly spaced key pads.

assets.title: Concert flute
assets.description: Concert flute with an inline head joint and visible round key cups.

assets.title: Concert harp
assets.description: Concert pedal harp at real size: fluted column with a carved crown, S-curved neck with brass tuning discs, tapered soundbox with a spruce soundboard, a fan of strings with red C and dark F marker strings, and seven brass pedals on the pedestal. Material controls: maple frame, spruce soundboard, brass fittings, gut strings, C and F marker strings. Concert, vintage and gilded presets.

assets.title: Conductor podium
assets.description: Small raised conductor podium with broad top, stepped riser and front access step.

assets.title: Conga drums
assets.description: Pair of tall conga drums with tapered-looking shells, top heads and floor feet.

assets.title: Double bass
assets.description: Upright double bass with a large body, long neck, bridge and floor endpin.

assets.title: Drum kit
assets.description: Compact drum kit with bass drum, supported snare and toms, cymbal stands and a stool.

assets.title: Electric guitar
assets.description: Solid-body electric guitar with a double-cutaway silhouette, pickup bars, bridge and headstock.

assets.title: French horn
assets.description: Coiled French horn prop with a flared bell, circular tubing loop and rotary valve block.

assets.title: Harmonica
assets.description: Ten-hole diatonic harmonica at real size: comb with ten mouth holes between its tines, brass reed plates showing as a line top and bottom, pressed stainless covers with a front lip, flat crown, open rear vents and closed rounded ends, plus cover screws. Material controls: stainless covers, brass reed plates and screws, comb polymer. Concert, vintage and pearwood presets.

assets.title: Maracas
assets.description: Pair of hand maracas with rounded shaker heads and straight handles.

assets.title: Marimba
assets.description: Marimba with long graduated bars, resonator tubes and a sturdy frame.

assets.title: Mechanical metronome
assets.description: Maelzel-style mechanical metronome at real size: tapered wooden case on a moulded plinth with a recessed front channel, ivory tempo scale with tick marks, steel pendulum with a brass sliding weight, brass winding key and turned apex finial. Material controls: walnut case, brass weight and key, steel pendulum, ivory scale; pendulum swing choice. Concert, vintage and ebonised presets.

assets.title: Microphone stand
assets.description: Stage microphone on a tripod stand with an angled boom arm and round grille head.

assets.title: Music stand
assets.description: Portable music stand with a broad score tray, adjustable stem and three floor feet.

assets.title: Oboe
assets.description: Double-reed oboe with a narrow tapered-looking body, bell, reed and small key pads.

assets.title: Orchestral cymbals
assets.description: Pair of thin orchestral crash cymbals with central bosses and short grips.

assets.title: Orchestral triangle
assets.description: Metal triangle percussion instrument with a three-sided frame and hanging striker.

assets.title: Snare drum
assets.description: Snare drum with a shallow shell, paired hoops and a simple carry-stand frame.

assets.title: Tambourine
assets.description: Hand tambourine with a broad ring and evenly spaced pairs of jingles.

assets.title: Tenor saxophone
assets.description: Larger tenor saxophone with a curved neck, broad bell and raised keywork.

assets.title: Timpani

assets.title: Tapered tower section
assets.description: Single steel tower segment with a flared lower collar and upper joint band. Controls: scale and painted steel, stainless steel; weathered and high-visibility presets.

assets.title: Tower section transport saddle
assets.description: Low transport cradle with V-shaped-looking supports, tie-down posts and skid rails. Controls: scale and structural steel, elastomer; weathered and high-visibility presets.

assets.title: Offshore transition piece
assets.description: Yellow offshore transition piece sleeved over a grey monopile stub, with grout skirt, cone and bolted tower flange, a grated ring platform on knee braces with guard rails, davit crane, watertight door, external J-tube and a boat landing of two fendered tubes with an access ladder and rest platform. Material controls: marine steel, transition-piece coating, galvanized steel and fender rubber; weathered, high-visibility and grey-coating presets.

assets.title: Tower base skirt
assets.description: Low polygon tower base fairing with a circular foot, raised skirt and access cutout panel. Controls: scale and structural steel, concrete, safety paint; weathered and high-visibility presets.

assets.title: Tower base access steps
assets.description: Three-step access stair with side stringers and a short top landing. Controls: scale and galvanized steel, safety paint; weathered and high-visibility presets.

assets.title: Blade root sleeve
assets.description: Short blade-root sleeve with a broad flange, inner collar and four attachment lugs. Controls: scale and fiberglass composite, stainless steel; weathered and high-visibility presets.

assets.title: Turbine control cabinet
assets.description: Ground control cabinet with double doors, shallow rain hood and bottom vent bank. Controls: scale and powder-coated steel, safety paint; weathered and high-visibility presets.

assets.title: Tower access door frame
assets.description: Access door frame prop with rectangular jambs, header and a threshold plate. Controls: scale and galvanized steel, stainless steel; weathered and high-visibility presets.

assets.title: Turbine junction box
assets.description: Compact sealed junction box with four cable glands, lid lip and mounting feet. Controls: scale and powder-coated steel, insulating polymer; weathered and high-visibility presets.

assets.title: Turbine nacelle shell
assets.description: Streamlined GRP nacelle cover on a transport frame: sloping rounded nose with main-shaft opening and bearing housing, bolted panel seams, roof service hatch with handrails, side ventilation louvres, rear roof cooler with fins and aviation lights, steel transport skids and saddles. Material controls: shell composite, frame and fittings steel, cooler aluminium, warning paint and transport-frame paint; weathered, highVisibility and darkGrey presets.

assets.title: Turbine number placard
assets.description: Small numbered turbine ID plate on a short post with a broad mounting foot. Controls: scale and safety paint, galvanized steel, concrete; weathered and high-visibility presets.

assets.title: Turbine rotor hub
assets.description: Bare three-blade rotor hub on a shop cradle: turned cast-iron hub body, three radial blade bosses with two-ring pitch bearings, blade studs and pitch-drive motors, rear main-shaft flange with bolts and shaft stub, nose spinner ring, steel cradle with timber pads. Material controls: hub casting paint, bearing steel, fasteners, cradle paint and timber; weathered, highVisibility and primer presets.

assets.title: Vertical-axis wind turbine
assets.description: Three-blade vertical-axis rotor with an open frame, central shaft, and radial supports. Controls: scale and galvanized steel, fiberglass composite, stainless steel; weathered and high-visibility presets.

assets.title: Wind farm access gate
assets.description: Two-post service gate with a framed swing panel and two weighted post shoes. Controls: scale and galvanized steel, safety paint; weathered and high-visibility presets.

assets.title: Wind farm meter pedestal
assets.description: Short metering pedestal with a cabinet head, status light and broad footplate. Controls: scale and powder-coated steel, polycarbonate; weathered and high-visibility presets.

assets.title: Wind-farm pad-mount transformer
assets.description: Outdoor transformer box with two side cooling banks, top bushings and concrete pad. Controls: scale and powder-coated steel, concrete, electrical ceramic, aluminium; weathered and high-visibility presets.

assets.title: Wind farm warning sign
assets.description: Field warning placard with two posts, reinforced top edge and weighted feet. Controls: scale and safety paint, galvanized steel, concrete; weathered and high-visibility presets.

assets.title: Wind site bollard
assets.description: Low site bollard with a rounded cap, square foot and two raised reflector bands. Controls: scale and safety paint, stainless steel, concrete; weathered and high-visibility presets.

assets.title: Wind turbine blade
assets.description: Single rotor blade standing on its bolted root: lofted, twisted airfoil from a round root through a wide shoulder to a slim tip, root flange with T-bolt studs and pitch mark, leading-edge protection strip, lightning receptor and warning tip band, on a steel root stand. Material controls: blade composite, leading-edge tape, warning paint, root steel and stand paint; weathered, highVisibility and unpaintedTip presets.
